description: Interactive code and document workspace with syntax highlighting, live preview, and direct editing via CodeMirror 6

tool_definition.name: TDA_Canvas
tool_definition.description: Presents code, documents, or structured content in an interactive canvas workspace with syntax highlighting, live preview for HTML/SVG/Markdown, direct editing, and durable version history. Canvases are persisted and addressable, so one created in an earlier session can be re-opened from any session. Use this for substantial content that benefits from a dedicated workspace rather than inline display.

action.description: Optional. Omit (or 'create') to create/update a canvas from 'content'. 'open' to open an existing canvas (by canvas_id or title) — works from any session. 'list' to list the user's canvases. 'update' to change an existing canvas (by canvas_id). 'delete' (canvas_id). 'restore' (canvas_id + version_id).

content.description: The complete source code or document content. Required for create/update; omit for open/list/delete/restore.

language.description: The content language: html, css, javascript, python, sql, markdown, json, svg, or mermaid.

title.description: A descriptive title for the canvas workspace. Reusing an existing title updates that canvas (recording a new version). Can also be passed to 'open' to open a canvas by name.

canvas_id.description: Stable canvas identifier. Use with 'open', 'update', 'delete', and 'restore' to target an existing canvas precisely (from any session).

version_id.description: Version identifier — required for 'restore' (together with canvas_id).

sources.description: Comma-separated list of knowledge source documents that informed this content. Include when generating content based on retrieved knowledge documents. Format: 'Document Title (collection)', 'Another Doc (collection)'
